If price was being supported and actively bought we would have seen a much better series of candles, but all we got for an entire days trading was weakness into the days high and a push through from the NY close which was nothing worth taking anyway, most of it was short stops being taken. You need to see price has come off an area where it made sense to see pro money buying from. The source of today's move was far from fresh ground and the proof was easy to see. The more times price returns to an area for another push will see less money flow into the market as more and more orders get filled on each touch.

Keep in mind we are closing towards more and more supply as price rises and pro money will start taking positions.

Hello Doctor,

I've noticed that several of the currency pairs are near to, in, or bouncing along (what I would consider, and mark as) longer time-frame Supply or Demand areas, just in time for GDP, bank rate and US NFP items next week.

I've seen this from time to time, so rather than think that recent Price Action is weak I tend to consider it 'Malice Aforethought': Pro Money have parked price at a convenient location where it can 'react' wildly to upcoming results (whether they be 'shock' or 'as expected'), hoovering up lots of weak positions, before heading off in their chosen direction (which might be to 'respect' current Supply / Demand or to push through to end goals). Which way it will go I cannot say, but I guess that's the point, price is at a place and a time where it acts like a honeypot trap, and all Pro Money have to do is wait until it's thick with flies...!

I don't have your experience or perspicacity, but am I thinking the current situation aright or have I just written utter tosh? I know it isn't coincidence

Thanks in advance of your reply.

Regards.

Spongy.

Many pairs line up on occasion and many will also turn in and about the same time. Higher time frames show it best.

News is used to great effect all the time and most of that noise ends after around 30 to 60 minutes after the news release. If I am not in the market while news comes out, I will stay out until price has settled back into its groove. Any form of news is abuse time, have you ever looked at stock prices when quarterly results are released?....most come out after the market close. The serious trades know to wait until the following day to take a position and let the after market traders punch it out first.

Back to the eur/usd today, we just saw a test of yesterdays weak bullish break as I called it. And just look at the reaction so far, hardly what I would call much interest in going long. We have 20 minutes for the NY open and lets see what that will bring. Any real strength wont come in unless we break yesterdays high and pull back into support. if we get support at all. Instead I will be sitting through the chop and watching the herd getting chopped to bits, great fun.

Hello Doctor,

Yes, I remember when I was young and foolish and thought the content of the news and all those opinion pieces held meaning (and if only I could work out how the market would react to it so I could place myself accordingly). Now I'm older and slightly less foolish, and I know it's all mummery to herd the unknowing willingly into a grand mugging. I've learned enough to stand aside until the dust settles, but I'm working hard on full enlightenment (which always seems to be just over the next hurdle and never in sight!).

So, I'm just being a conspiracy nut then? I thought Pro Money were holding prices at levels where different traders could apply different tools and derive different reasons to enter the market just before a series of 'potentially disruptive' news items could be used as an excuse to wipe them all out (just looking at EURUSD on D1, I'm sure you could claim Resistance level, Supply area, respected 20/50/200MA, respected trend channel, RSI or stochastics oversold, Fib extension level, and hey Elliott Wave for the fun of it). And all this such that at the end of next week people would be talking about the unexpected and directionless volatility, and Pro Money would be thinking, "which was only possible with your help and participation, so yeah, thanks for helping us to scale in/out".

Regards.

Spongy.

Spongy,

There are many who are old and foolish and have yet to reach the age of reason. Some never make it and they are chasing rainbows their entire lives. As for enlightenment, I doubt it ever comes, I still make new discoveries and learn as time passes. The best lesson by far I ever learned was patience.

Money only makes money when it is put to work, there is nothing gained for having static money. It may as well be in a bank then and working for someone else. I dont like giving banks interest free loans on my money where they have no need to provide me with written guarantees of being able to pay back. Instead I put the screws on them and have zero bank charges. I dont see why I should be paying them for being a customer. Anyway, onwards......

Pro money appear to be holding when one of two things are happening, there are accumulating or distributing. Pro money is always in motion and currencies in particular are a 24hr market which gives more opportunity than trading stocks. The major moves from London or NY wont show typically up in the Asia session and smaller gains have to be accepted. As you will know by now, I am no fan of indicators and they take their place in the compost pile. The entire weeks move to the current high was about 120 points, not very impressive is it, where were the bulls?

Price has fixated on a 4hr S/R area with a very small window over head for the bulls and this last push is a real struggle. And with familiar words, we wait once again.

Its been a poor enough week to learn candle sticks, but the choppy conditions have the effect of letting you know when not to trade as well.

At the moment if you look on the 2nd last 4hr candle, it closed higher than the previous candle and yet this is bearish. Given that the previous candle engulfed three candles prior, it means there was a lack of demand and price at best made it back to an S/R area. The 1hr shows this support coming in and as yet no buyers are interested. Way down on the 5min I see price having a hard time pushing up taking note of a long wick where lots of sellers came in. There is a possibility of a sell off into the NY close. Its too early to tell at the moment and pure speculation, but I sure wont take any long term trades at this hour.

As we approach the top of this range I will look for active bears. Any breakout to the upside will not bring me in.

Thank you very much for spending your time showing us how you read the markets.

glory305, the eur/aud monthly shows a clear change in direction, the pair is bullish. If you wish to sell it will be on a low time frame and not an easy trade. The more profitable direction is in the same direction with pro money.

Christian, the most simplistic explanation I have is also removing a lot of detail on how I look at the market. But in essence I take the higher time frames and mark supply and demand. I look for where price reacted as is moved from these areas. As price gets back to them at a later time, I will watch all lower time frames for price action as it enters the areas of interest. Candle reading from there is very important as well as reading them as a group, one of my main entries is break out, pullback, failure and then enter.

Like I said, this is a very simplistic way to look at it and the devil is in the details. Price must get low before it will be bought by pro money, and price must rise before pro money will sell into it. There is a lot of upside in the pair on glory305's chart and note the current 4hr chart, see the break?....now wait for price to come back and gain support, price action will tell you in the pro's are loading up again for a continuation move. I only take the best setups I see and will scale in as price works as I expect it to, but only after I see proof it is taking in pro money. homer, you have it correct. The entry is only taken after as many as possible false moves are eliminated and the true direction known as best we can read it. We can never fully eliminate all the false moves, but this approach is close as it gets to perfect. Additional help is given to you when pro money start piling in and the price action in the candles show this graphically.

While I mentioned the word failure in a previous post I want to be sure you all know what that means. It is not that there is a rejection of a lower or higher price, but a particular group of traders who have failed to continue move price. Price does not fail to go lower or higher, but the active traders who took the break did not have the financial means to continue with the move, which then becomes a failure of the least well funded traders. Pro money use that to their advantage because it gets them better entry prices. You can see it in action with highly defensive moves away from prices where the pro's started loading up.

Picture where this can happen, if an old top to the left of us is broken and price comes back, if the continuation move up doesnt come it simply means the amount of sell orders in the market is greater than the funds of the ill funded traders who tried to maintain the long position. When break out/pull back happens, this is where you can expect the see either a continuation or failure. A few posts back I mentioned the three ways in which the market moves, either one can happen around the areas we are talking about.

When a move ends, it will also behave in one of the three ways I mentioned. Who ever would have guessed it is so familiar:)

When a break comes and price returns, pro money are interested. Especially if its in an interesting price area.

Long before a move begins and a little less long before a move ends, pro money stamp their authority and a good example of this was seen on the eur/gpb july 26th. Heavy buying came in and I scaled in a few lots. I knew we had over head resistance and messy supply which looked weak. But rather than place all of ones money in the market, I thought it prudent to wait for the likely break/pullback and then scale in long again once the market had shown it was in bullish hands. A real trend on low time frames is established and I am out at 87 flat. Any higher is not of interest, thats the emotional rush for scalpers which will probably come to be true. Plus, there is a lot of sell orders over head going way back.

Chanya, you noticed your mistake after it had been placed. The key is to see it in real time and wait for the entry after pro money have decided where price will go. It is not an easy thing to do with the little ticker on the right edge of screen tugging the strings of emotion.

The engulf you saw does not say the same thing to me. I dont consider it an engulf unless the body of the candle to the left is fully engulfed with a close outside of its body range, and ideally the total range. Price has been in a range for a long time now and in the past few recent candles on your chart we can see a false move up and a false move down. Pro money were keen to see if stops and orders were there and if enough were in place to justify pushing price. Clearly neither the bulls or bears were satisfied and price is once again settling into the established range.

Where you and many others will have gone wrong is playing the fast moves from price, this will burn a hole in your pocket real fast. Price has to break free of what range it is inside, then come back close to the move out. Then watch price action for signs of pro money coming in to help get the market moving. When longs tails and spikes appear from testing a ranges extremes it is never good for traders of any capacity.

A useful exercise is to jump back a year or more in time with the pair you prefer to trade. Turn off the data feed so that you can see static candles. Then look for a move on a high tome frame and gradually drop down in time until you can see what clean price action looks like when the pull test and retests are done. Do not look for patterns because pro money know better than to provide you with a road map. It will look different each time, and what I want is for you to get the fear from your mind and watch how price reacts. There will be a clear story when it clicks, and be sure you boxes on historic supply and demand. It is within these boxes that you will really focus on price action and the deeper into the the box or even through it price goes the better. The point is, pro money must do all they can to make it appear that if you dont get in now, you will miss the move. The set you up for a fall and it works on most retail traders.

An example which may be closed by the time I finish this is my eur/gpb long trade which is closing at 87.000. Price will push so hard that the herd will come in buying like crazy cos they are missing out. Great, it means I get my profit in the move up which I took when the herd was not interested. Trace the price back and see can you also spot on that pair where pro money came in and where an R/S area was breached and tested.

Chanya، اشتباهت را بعد از اینکه گذاشته شده بودی متوجه شدی. نکته این است که آن را در لحظه ببینی و برای ورود بعد از اینکه پول حرفه‌ای تصمیم گرفت قیمت کجا می‌رود صبر کنی. با آن تیکر کوچک لبهٔ راست صفحه که نخ‌های احساسات را می‌کشد کار آسانی نیست.

اینگالفی که دیدی برای من همان معنا را نمی‌دهد. تا وقتی بدنهٔ کندلِ سمت چپ کاملاً اینگالف نشده و خارج از رنجِ بدنه‌اش با بسته شدن نهایی بسته نشود — و در حالت ایده‌آل کل رنج — آن را اینگالف نمی‌دانم. قیمت مدتی است که در رنج است و در چند کندل اخیرِ چارتت می‌توانیم حرکت کاذب به بالا و حرکت کاذب به پایین را ببینیم. پول حرفه‌ای مشتاق بود ببینند آیا استاپ‌ها و سفارش‌ها آن‌جا هستند و آیا به‌اندازهٔ کافی برای توجیه هول‌دادن قیمت هست یا نه. واضح است که نه خریداران و نه خرس‌ها راضی بودند و قیمت دوباره دارد به رنجِ تثبیت‌شده می‌نشیند.

جایی که تو و خیلی‌های دیگر اشتباه کرده‌اید بازی کردنِ حرکت‌های سریعِ قیمت است؛ این خیلی سریع در جیب‌ات سوراخ می‌سوزاند. قیمت باید از رنجی که داخلش است آزاد شود، بعد نزدیکِ حرکتِ بیرون‌رفتن برگردد. بعد price action را برای نشانه‌های ورود پول حرفه‌ای برای کمک به حرکت بازار تماشا کن. وقتی دم‌ها و spike‌های خرید از تستِ افراط‌های رنج ظاهر می‌شوند، برای تریدرهای هر ظرفیتی هیچ‌وقت خوب نیست.

یک تمرین مفید این است که در زمان به یک سال یا بیشتر قبل برگردی با جفت‌ارزی که دوست داری معامله کنی. منبع داده را خاموش کن تا کندل‌های ثابت ببینی. بعد دنبال حرکتی روی تایم‌فریم بالا بگرد و تدریجی در زمان پایین بیا تا ببینی price action تمیز وقتی پولبک و تست مجدد انجام می‌شوند چه شکلی است. دنبال الگو نگرد چون پول حرفه‌ای بهتر از این می‌داند که نقشهٔ راه به تو بدهد. هر بار متفاوت به نظر می‌رسد، و چیزی که می‌خواهم این است که ترس را از ذهنت بیرون کنی و تماشا کنی قیمت چطور واکنش نشان می‌دهد. وقتی جا می‌افتد داستان روشنی خواهد بود، و مطمئن شو باکس‌هایی روی عرضه و تقاضای تاریخی می‌گذاری. درون همین باکس‌هاست که واقعاً روی price action تمرکز می‌کنی و هرچه عمیق‌تر به داخل باکس یا حتی از آن عبور کند قیمت بهتر است. نکته این است: پول حرفه‌ای باید همهٔ کاری را بکند تا به نظر برسد اگر الان وارد نشوی، حرکت را از دست می‌دهی. تو را برای سقوط تله می‌گذارند و روی بیشتر تریدرهای خرده‌فروش کار می‌کند.

مثالی که شاید تا وقتی این را تمام می‌کنم بسته شده باشد، معاملهٔ خرید eur/gbp من است که در 87.000 می‌بندد. قیمت آن‌قدر سخت هول می‌دهد که توده مثل دیوانه‌ها می‌آید و می‌خرد چون جا مانده‌اند. عالی؛ یعنی سود من در حرکت صعودی است که وقتی توده علاقه نداشت گرفتم. قیمت را به عقب ردیابی کن و ببین آیا می‌توانی روی آن جفت‌ارز هم ببینی پول حرفه‌ای کجا وارد شد و کجا ناحیهٔ R/S شکسته و تست شد.

ویرایش: 3 دقیقه بعد از پست… دینگ، ممنون توده.

Guys I was reading some of the old posts. Here you can see that knowing something about fundementals can help alot.

Doctor wrote: Taking a zoomed out view on the weekly there should be obvious room for profit on this chart. The higher time frames give more guidance than day traders tend to give credit, the attitude is, it takes so long for them to close that opportunities are missed. Whats really missing is the benefit from the obvious and easiest route to a target and where it is clear to see. If you take the same pair and drop down one time frame at a time and see where this move began. Do you see anything interesting in the price action in the very recent past i.e last few days?

Now look at historic bottoms to the left, note the deep spikes into price, this is removing pro bull orders and if the same thing has been done a number of times in the past, how much additional orders do you think are left?......likely little or none. Books tells you the more an area is tested it will form strong support. Sorry book authors, but that is complete tripe and as far from the truth as it gets. The more an area is tested the weaker it becomes in the direction of the original move away, bullish in this instance.

Perhaps I should write a new trading book. Opinions for titles?......The day trader and the manure from media and Wall st......nah too long.

Lower in the chart I placed an S/R line. This is an obvious target and the single spike down will be a nice reaction area when price gets close to it. I do not have a crystal ball and cannot say how this will play out, all I know is that we will eventually get down there and from this time frame I want to see the most logical and obvious place for profit. Would you buy where we are right now?.....look at the historic highs, all preceding highs are getting lower and no clear desire to go higher.

Given the fundamentals for the Australian economy and their banks dependance on over seas funding it is likely their economy will shrink and a taste of doom and gloom set in. This is already been shown in export figures and the Gov wish to now make closer ties with Asia for free trade etc. Sure it has been talked about for a long time, but when you can no longer hide behind or massage the numbers (not hinting any gov would ever do this of course) it is then time you need to do what should have been done long ago. China is a major importer of Australian raw materials and they too will continue to drop off now. What has this got to do with us trading currencies?.........There are three monthly candles per quarter, and gov figures come out each quarter. To see the bigger picture be aware of what the numbers are and what they tell. Compare the gov story to the forex market and see which is giving you both direction and room for profit and then look to lower time frames for entry based on price action.

The precursor to a market fall is bad news. Even if the market was setting up on a higher time frame to fall, pro money like to hide their intentions for a time prior to this by ramping price. This gets you in and helps then filter out some of the long held positions, and as momentum takes over then buy take the positions you now place so they now trade against you. As time marches onward I expect to hear more bad news about Australia and the currency move lower.

There is about 800 points in the move lower. We will wait for our chance to grab a piece of that.

بچه‌ها داشتم بعضی پست‌های قدیمی را می‌خواندم. اینجا می‌بینید که دانستن چیزی دربارهٔ مبانی می‌تواند خیلی کمک کند.

Doctor نوشت: با نگاهِ دور روی هفتگی باید جای سودِ آشکاری روی این چارت باشد. تایم‌فریم‌های بالاتر راهنمایی بیشتری می‌دهند از آنچه تریدرهای روزانه معمولاً اعتبار می‌دهند؛ نگرش این است که چون خیلی طول می‌کشد بسته شوند، فرصت‌ها از دست می‌روند. چیزی که واقعاً جا افتاده فایدهٔ مسیرِ آشکار و آسان‌ترین به تارگت است و جایی که واضح دیده می‌شود. اگر همان جفت‌ارز را برداری و هر بار یک تایم‌فریم پایین‌تر بیایی و ببینی این حرکت کجا شروع شد. در price actionِ خیلی اخیر یعنی چند روز گذشته چیزی جالب می‌بینی؟

حالا به کف‌های تاریخی سمت چپ نگاه کن؛ به spike‌های عمیق به داخل قیمت توجه کن؛ این سفارش‌های خرس حرفه‌ای را برمی‌دارد و اگر همین کار تعداد بارهایی در گذشته انجام شده، فکر می‌کنی چند سفارش اضافه باقی مانده؟… احتمالاً کم یا هیچ. کتاب‌ها می‌گویند هرچه ناحیه بیشتر تست شود حمایت قوی‌تری می‌سازد. متأسفم نویسندگان کتاب، ولی این کاملاً دروغ است و دورترین چیز از حقیقت. هرچه ناحیه بیشتر تست شود در جهت حرکت اصلیِ دورشده ضعیف‌تر می‌شود؛ در این مورد صعودی.

شاید باید کتاب معامله جدیدی بنویسم. نظر برای عنوان؟… معامله‌گر روزانه و فضولات رسانه و وال‌استریت… نه، طولانی است.

پایین‌تر در چارت یک خط S/R گذاشتم. این تارگتی آشکار است و spike تکی به پایین وقتی قیمت به آن نزدیک شود ناحیهٔ واکنش خوبی خواهد بود. گوی بلورین ندارم و نمی‌توانم بگویم چطور پیش می‌رود؛ تنها چیزی که می‌دانم این است که بالاخره آن‌جا می‌رسیم و از این تایم‌فریم می‌خواهم منطقی‌ترین و آشکارترین جای سود را ببینم. آیا الان همان‌جایی که هستیم می‌خریدی؟… به سقف‌های تاریخی نگاه کن؛ همهٔ سقف‌های قبلی پایین‌تر می‌آیند و میل روشنی به بالاتر رفتن نیست.

با توجه به مبانی اقتصاد استرالیا و وابستگی بانک‌هایشان به تأمین مالی خارجی، احتمالاً اقتصادشان کوچک می‌شود و بویی از رکود و تاریکی می‌آید. این قبلاً در ارقام صادرات نشان داده شده و دولت حالا می‌خواهد پیوندهای نزدیک‌تری با آسیا برای تجارت آزاد و غیره بسازد. بله، مدت‌هاست درباره‌اش حرف زده می‌شود، اما وقتی دیگر نمی‌توانی پشت اعداد پنهان شوی یا آن‌ها را دست‌کاری کنی (البته اشاره نمی‌کنم که دولتی این کار را بکند)، وقتش است کاری را بکنی که باید مدت‌ها پیش می‌کردی. چین واردکنندهٔ اصلی مواد خام استرالیاست و آن‌ها هم حالا به‌تدریج افت می‌کنند. این چه ربطی به معامله ارزهایمان دارد؟… هر سه‌ماهه 3 کندل ماهانه دارد و ارقام دولت هر سه‌ماهه بیرون می‌آید. برای دیدن تصویر بزرگ‌تر آگاه باش ارقام چه می‌گویند و چه می‌گویند. داستان دولت را با بازار فارکس مقایسه کن و ببین کدام‌یک هم جهت و هم جای سود به تو می‌دهد و بعد برای ورود بر اساس price action تایم‌فریم‌های پایین‌تر را نگاه کن.

پیش‌درآمد سقوط بازار خبر بد است. حتی اگر بازار روی تایم‌فریم بالاتر برای سقوط در حال ستاپ باشد، پول حرفه‌ای دوست دارد قبل از این برای مدتی نیت‌هایش را پنهان کند با بالا بردن قیمت. این تو را وارد می‌کند و بعد به فیلتر کردن بعضی پوزیشن‌های لانگِ نگه‌داشته‌شده کمک می‌کند و وقتی مومنتوم دست‌به‌کار شد، تریدرهای خرید را می‌گیرند تا حالا پوزیشن‌هایی که می‌گذاری برعلیه تو معامله کنند. با پیشروی زمان انتظار دارم خبر بد بیشتری دربارهٔ استرالیا و حرکت ارز به پایین بشنوم.

در حرکت به پایین حدود 800 پوینت هست. منتظر شانس‌مان می‌مانیم که تکه‌ای از آن را بگیریم.
